title: Keep reference-range evaluation total for missing requests
source: lib/ohworks-reference-range.ts:5-11 promises a total, never-throwing evaluator; :144 dereferences input before validation, whereas :194-196 already returns structured invalid results. prompt:
Honor the reference-range evaluator's documented non-throwing boundary for missing requests. lib/ohworks-reference-range.ts:5-11 describes a total function that classifies uninterpretable input as invalid. The implementation at line 144 dereferences input.unit before validating the enclosing request, so evaluateReferenceRange(null) reproduced a native TypeError. Undefined has the same problem, while malformed individual fields already flow into the structured invalid result at lines 194-196. This is a local input-boundary defect, not a change to range classification policy.

Add an early guard for null, undefined, primitive, and array request values before any property access. Return classification invalid with the existing invalid report flag and a deterministic input-malformed reason added to the local reason-code union. Keep the valid ReferenceRangeInput caller contract usable; tests may use explicit casts to exercise runtime-invalid input. Do not introduce exceptions, I/O, broad exception swallowing, or changes to numeric and censored-result classification. Preserve sorted existing reasons for object requests with malformed fields.

Extend tests/ohworks/reference-range.test.ts with null, undefined, primitives, and arrays, asserting that every call returns the expected invalid shape without throwing.
